form_title: (no county form) — the filer's own itemization spreadsheet: 'Itemized Contributions Received Exceeding $50.00' / 'Itemized Expenditures Made'

reports.notes: NOT a county form and NOT an image — this is the one spreadsheet filing in the corpus (the state `disclosures.utah.gov/Municipal/utah_2024` channel served it as .xlsx). Read from the workbook cells, not from a rendered page. It carries NO cover block at all: no office line, no political party, no Type-of-Report checkbox, no signature and no date, and no balance ladder — those fields are honestly absent from the document, not unreadable. The filer's own name appears only inside the ledger ('Friends of Alan Wessman' / 'Alan Wessman' as self-contributors); `candidate_printed` is taken from index.csv-corroborating ledger text plus the workbook filename. The sheet spans TWO reporting periods (7 days before the primary and 7 days before the general) and prints a per-period subtotal for each plus one cycle TOTAL; because no single per-period figure describes the whole document, the per-period slots are left BLANK and only the cycle totals are carried, with every printed subtotal preserved verbatim above. Itemized donor/vendor lines exist in this file and are NOT transcribed in this tranche (cover + stated totals only).

notes: Companion to Alan Wessman's PDF filings in the same 2024 cycle (raw/2024/2024_Alan_Wessman_Redacted_1_.pdf and _Redacted2.pdf) — retained and transcribed as its own filing because index.csv holds it as one, but its money is the SAME cycle's money. Do not add its totals to the PDFs' totals.
